Dazu zählen z.B. unser Kassensystem DISH POS, die DISH Payment Lösungen und das DISH Reservierungstool. Unsere Gesellschaft bietet damit wettbewerbsfähige Lösungen für einige der relevantesten Herausforderungen der Branche. Mehr als 380.000 Gastronomen in 16 Ländern nutzen bereits unsere digitalen Lösungen, um ihre Geschäftsergebnisse zu verbessern. Unsere Kunden und Kundinnen aus der Gastronomie sind unsere Motivation - mit Leidenschaft, Kompetenz und Empathie tun wir alles dafür, sie optimal zu unterstützen. Dabei sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unser Erfolgsrezept. Wir sind stolz darauf, dass unsere vielfältigen Teams mit hohem Engagement jeden Tag zum Erfolg von METRO beitragen. Aufbau von Kundenbeziehungen: Als Sales Professional begeisterst Du die von Dir neu akquirierten Kunden und unsere Bestandskunden von unseren digitalen Lösungen. Teamwork: Du bildest ein erfolgreiches Team mit dem Vertriebsinnendienst und den Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsaußendienst der METRO Deutschland. Produktentwicklung: Du holst strukturiertes Feedback von unserer Kundschaft ein und leitest Deine Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen an das Produktentwicklungsteam weiter. Reporting: Deine Erfolge treiben Dich an! Du verantwortest das Reporting aller relevanten Kennzahlen und Deiner Vertriebserfolge – dazu gehört auch die verbindliche Dokumentation von mindestens 20 wöchentlichen Kundenterminen in unserem internen Sales Tool. Einarbeitung & Weiterentwicklung: Dich erwartet eine hervorragende Einarbeitung und die Möglichkeit, Deine Vertriebs- und Produktkenntnisse mit Hilfe von Coaches und unserem internen House of Learning zu entwickeln. Profil Ausbildung / Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Vertrieb / Vertriebsaußendienst (gerne aus dem Bereich Gastronomie, Versicherungen, Online Marketing, Payment, Telekommunikation, etc.) und hast Spaß am Schnittstellenmanagement. Vertriebskenntnisse : Eine Leidenschaft für aktives Verkaufen (incl. Neukunden-Akquise) und die betriebswirtschaftliche Steuerung der Zielerreichung setzen wir natürlich voraus. Digitales Know-How : Du hast ein gutes digitales Verständnis und interessierst Dich für die Digitalisierung der Gastronomie. Organisation : Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise ist ein Muss. Persönlichkeit: Du bist stark in der Kommunikation und kannst schnell neue Kontakte knüpfen und Menschen begeistern. Fahrerlaubnis: Du verfügst über einen gültigen PKW-Führerschein und bist gerne beim Kunden vor Ort. Wir bieten Weshalb solltest Du Dich bewerben? Mobiles Arbeiten mit flexiblen, vertrauensbasierten Arbeitszeiten im Außendienst Deiner Region (idealerweise wohnst Du im Vertriebsgebiet, geringe auswärtige Übernachtungen) Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung und Belohnung Deines Vertriebserfolges durch ein attraktives Prämienmodel und Incentives Attraktive Möglichkeiten zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inkl. The role will act as a senior technical authority across CCTV/VMS, Access Control, Intrusion & Perimeter Security, PSIM, Security Communications and Fire Alarm/Life Safety, ensuring high-quality, compliant and constructible engineering deliverables. 🔑 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Lead and manage Physical Security & Fire Alarm engineering teams across multiple projects. • Review and approve engineering designs, calculations, drawings, BOQs, technical submittals and shop drawings. • Establish engineering standards, QA/QC procedures, design checklists and technical practices. • Manage resources, workloads, priorities and delivery schedules across concurrent projects. • Coordinate with KSA project teams, consultants, clients, BIM, ICT, Electrical, MEP, Procurement and Commercial teams. • Identify design risks, scope gaps, compliance issues and integration dependencies and drive them to closure. • Lead technical workshops, design reviews and consultant/client coordination meetings. • Support projects from Tender & Concept Design through Detailed Design, IFC/Shop Drawings, Testing, Commissioning and Handover. • Coach and develop engineers and designers while building strong in-house technical capabilities. 🛡️ CORE ENGINEERING SCOPE Physical Security Enterprise CCTV / VMS design and architecture. Camera selection, FOV, pixel density, DORI and coverage calculations. VMS architecture, servers, storage, recording, redundancy and licensing. Access Control for doors, gates, turnstiles, elevators and restricted areas. Controller/panel architecture, readers, locks, REX, emergency release and power calculations. Perimeter Security & Intrusion Detection. Security gates, barriers, bollards, vehicle screening and related interfaces. Security intercom, help points, emergency phones and duress systems. PSIM / Command & Control integration and alarm workflows. Fire Alarm & Life Safety Addressable fire alarm systems and network architecture. Fire alarm loops, devices, panels, modules and notification systems. Loop loading, voltage drop, power supply and battery calculations. Cause & Effect and integration with HVAC, BMS, elevators, access control, smoke control, fire pumps and emergency power. Fire alarm zoning, graphics, redundancy and fire command-centre requirements. Compliance with applicable Saudi Civil Defence / SBC / NFPA / EN standards. 🏗️ DESIGN & TECHNICAL OFFICE The role will be responsible for reviewing and coordinating: ✔ Basis of Design & Design Narratives ✔ System Architecture & Block Diagrams ✔ SLDs, Risers & Network Topologies ✔ Device & Equipment Layouts ✔ CCTV Coverage & Storage Calculations ✔ Access Control I/O & Power Calculations ✔ Fire Alarm Loop & Battery Calculations ✔ BOQs / BOMs / Equipment Schedules ✔ Technical Submittals & Material Approvals ✔ Shop Drawings & Method Statements ✔ BIM / Revit Coordination ✔ RFIs & Technical Clarifications ✔ FAT / SAT / Testing & Commissioning Support ✔ Authority Inspections & Handover 🎓 REQUIREMENTS • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Communications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline. • 12+ years of relevant Physical Security / ELV / Fire Alarm engineering experience. • 4–5+ years in a Senior Lead, Discipline Lead or Engineering Management role is strongly preferred. • Strong hands-on experience in enterprise CCTV/VMS and Access Control. • Fire Alarm design experience is mandatory. • Proven experience with large-scale / mega projects and complex multi-building developments. • Experience in consultant design review, tender, IFC, shop drawings and construction-stage coordination. • KSA / GCC mega-project experience is strongly preferred. • Strong knowledge of security and life-safety integration. • Strong written and spoken English. 💻 TECHNICAL SKILLS Strong expertise in: • CCTV / VMS Architecture • Access Control Systems • Perimeter & Intrusion Detection • PSIM / Security Management Systems • Fire Alarm Systems • Cause & Effect / Life Safety Integration • IP Networking & Security Systems • AutoCAD & Revit/BIM coordination • BOQ / BOM / Technical Documentation • Engineering Calculations & Design Reviews Experience with platforms such as Genetec, Milestone, LenelS2, Johnson Controls/Tyco, Honeywell, Avigilon, Axis, Bosch, Hanwha or equivalent is highly valued. Fire Alarm experience with Honeywell/Notifier, Siemens, Edwards/EST, Johnson Controls/Tyco, Bosch or equivalent systems is also highly valued. 📜 PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS • ASIS PSP or equivalent security credential • NFPA 72 training / Fire Alarm Design certification • Manufacturer certifications in VMS, Access Control or Fire Alarm • Networking certifications • PMP / Project Management training 🌍 KSA PROJECT EXPOSURE Experience supporting or delivering projects in Saudi Arabia / GCC is a strong advantage, particularly exposure to: • Saudi Building Code • Saudi Civil Defence requirements • HCIS / MOI / Royal Commission requirements • PIF or other major KSA project requirements • Consultant / Authority approval processes ⭐ WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who can operate as both a hands-on technical authority and an effective people manager — someone capable of moving from high-level security strategy and system architecture down to detailed camera calculations, access-control I/O and fire-alarm loop calculations, while leading teams and delivering coordinated, buildable designs for mega projects. 📩 Apply now or share your profile with us at [hr@beatpeopleg.com]. In the subject line, please mention  “ Physical Security & Fire Alarm Engineering Manager” - Join us in shaping the future of a world-class organization! 🌏

review_candidates.title: Payroll Manager, APAC
review_candidates.description: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity As Flexport continues to grow its footprint across Asia Pacific, we're looking for a Payroll Manager to be the cornerstone of payroll excellence across the region. You'll own the full payroll cycle for our APAC entities - spanning Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Greater China, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines, India and other new markets as we expand - and serve as the go-to expert where precision, compliance, and people experience intersect. Sitting within the APAC People team and reporting to the Senior Director, People APAC, this is a people-manager role leading a team of one, with significant cross-functional visibility. You'll set the regional payroll operating standard, drive payroll strategy, build out your team as scale demands, and work closely with Finance, People Operations, and business partners to ensure every employee across APAC is paid accurately and on time. What You'll Do Own Regional Payroll End to End: Lead monthly payroll processing across 18+ APAC entities, managing vendor relationships and ensuring timely, accurate execution at scale. Handle Direct Payroll Execution: Perform hands-on processing and verification for assigned entities, directly coordinating with payroll vendors to calculate and finalize local payroll runs. Lead & Develop the Team: Manage and grow a direct report responsible for payroll data preparation - set priorities, review quality, and build a team structure that scales with new-market growth. Drive Data Accuracy: Coordinate with Finance on payment funding, GL booking, cost centre allocation, and month-end reconciliations - keeping payroll and finance in lockstep. Support the Full Employee Lifecycle: Own off-cycle payments, bonus runs, and statutory pay calculations across all employment events, ensuring compliance with local labour requirements. Enable Compliant Growth: Partner with the Expansion team to onboard new APAC entities onto payroll - from vendor setup to first run - as Flexport enters new markets. Support on regional bonus scheme: partner with global and regional stakeholders on incentive plan. Be the Audit & Compliance Expert: Own external audit requests, maintain payroll documentation standards, and manage compliance notifications as the business evolves. Elevate Vendor Performance: Own vendor SLA performance across a large multi-vendor footprint, proactively resolving service issues and driving consistent quality across all markets. Own Leave & Statutory Pay Calculations: Calculate maternity, paternity, sick, and other statutory leave pay amounts across all APAC entities, coordinating with People Ops on eligibility determination. Manage Overtime Compliance: Ensure accurate, compliant overtime calculations across markets with strict statutory multiplier requirements. Administer Post-Employment Payments: Process ongoing non-compete payments and other post-termination obligations, tracking start and stop dates for accuracy. Execute Compensation Changes: Process merit increases and promotions once approved, including any required backpay adjustments, accurately and on schedule. Lead Annual Compliance Cycles: Own annual individual income tax reconciliation and social insurance/housing fund base adjustments across applicable markets. Manage Equity-Related Withholding: Handle tax withholding and reporting obligations triggered by RSU vesting events across jurisdictions. What We're Looking For 8+ years of hands-on APAC payroll experience, including 3+ years managing/leading a team, and demonstrated ownership of 5+ countries' payroll operations at scale (ideally 10+). Broad multi-country payroll experience across the region - Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Greater China, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines, India - with a track record of standing up new-market payroll from scratch. Deep knowledge of statutory compliance, local labour laws, and payroll vendor management across a large, diverse APAC footprint. Proven people-management experience - able to coach, delegate, and build capability in a small but scaling team. Hands-on experience using modern AI assistants to automate data analysis, reporting, and modelling. Proven ability to partner with Finance on reconciliations, GL allocations, and audit deliverables. A reputation for precision - you hold yourself and your team to a high bar and catch issues before they reach employees. Strong communicator who can work fluidly across Finance, People Operations, and People Business Partners. Experience with HRIS platforms, specifically Workday. Professional proficiency in English is a MUST. Energised by a fast-scaling environment and excited to build payroll infrastructure and a team from the ground up in new markets. Comfortable challenging ideas and holding space for other perspectives to be heard. Strong logical approach to resolving complex issues and adept at fostering resilience. Committed to maintaining a high degree of personal integrity and confidentiality. Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.
